tasks.title: Countdown generator
tasks.statement: Write a generator function countdown(n): it yields the numbers from n down to 1 (nothing for n = 0). Use yield.

tasks.title: Fibonacci generator
tasks.statement: Write an infinite generator fib_gen(): the Fibonacci numbers 0, 1, 1, 2, 3, 5, …
tasks.hint: a, b = 0, 1; while True: yield a; a, b = b, a + b.

tasks.title: Evens up to a limit
tasks.statement: Write a generator evens(limit): the even non-negative numbers strictly less than limit.
tasks.hint: for x in range(0, limit, 2): yield x.

tasks.title: Batches
tasks.statement: Write a generator chunks(items, n): it yields the list in parts of n elements each (the last one may be shorter).
tasks.hint: for i in range(0, len(items), n): yield items[i:i + n].

tasks.title: Flatten nested lists
tasks.statement: Write a generator flatten(items): it yields, in order, all the non-list elements of arbitrarily nested lists. Use yield from and recursion.
tasks.hint: if isinstance(x, list): yield from flatten(x); else: yield x.

tasks.title: Numbers from lines
tasks.statement: Write a generator read_numbers(lines): from a sequence of strings it yields the integers. Empty strings and strings that are not a number (after strip they contain more than digits) are skipped.
tasks.hint: s = line.strip(); if s.isdigit(): yield int(s).

tasks.title: Running sums
tasks.statement: Write a generator running_sum(nums): after each element it yields the sum of all elements up to and including it: for 1, 2, 3, 4 it gives 1, 3, 6, 10.
tasks.hint: total = 0; for x in nums: total += x; yield total.

tasks.title: Your own context manager
tasks.statement: Using the contextmanager decorator from contextlib, define a manager tag(name): on entry it prints <name>, on exit (even on an error) it prints </name>.
tasks.hint: @contextmanager; print on entry; try: yield; finally: print on exit.
